pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/fleet/sub_settings/FleetSettingsPage.tsx:42 Fleet installs six hooks into the user-global ~/.claude/settings.json, which then run on sessions that never asked for them (including any external claude in the same cwd), but when fleet_check_hooks fails the error is swallowed, status stays null and the banner shows 'Loading hook status…' forever, so 'could not tell' collapses into a non-answer and no test in the suite covers that case.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/fleet/sub_settings/FleetSettingsPage.tsx:42 Install and uninstall failures are toasted loudly and checkHooks compares the declared events and port against what is actually registered. The check's own failure is silent, though: FleetHookBanner.tsx:38 renders 'Loading hook status…' for a null status, and FleetSettingsPage.test.tsx has no mockRejected case. Of the three required outcomes, 'could not tell' is missing.
